LVCOMP-V2-024.notes: uid_5132 shows confrontation between Sierra and the blonde woman with security intervention, but no on-screen name confirms Kindall and the sampled frames do not clearly show a sustained fight.

LVCOMP-V2-025.notes: uid_5145 lower-third names Alexis and reads "Says she's Brian's first love" (on-screen spelling Brian, not Brain). uid_5142 alone does not prove she is the last person to appear in the second interview.

LVCOMP-V2-031.notes: uid_808 shows a boy steal a golden S-shaped object after tickling the demon's nose with a pink leaf held in his hand. The leaf-on-his-head wording is not clearly confirmed; official leave spelling is not rewritten into a new action.
